theMicrophoneIsStrong: The microphone is muted (the computer reports it as muted). Unmute it: the mute key of the keyboard, or Windows Settings › System › Sound › Input, or Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone. This message goes away by itself when it is unmuted.
orOpenTheSite: Or open the site in Chrome: tap the lock or sliders icon at the left of the address, then Permissions, and allow the Microphone. No icon? Tap the three dots, then Settings, Site settings, Microphone.
nothingWasHeardSo: Nothing was heard, so the recording was not kept. The microphone was set up again without the sound filters of the browser: record once more.
nothingWasHeardSo2: Nothing was heard, so the recording was not kept. Check that the microphone is not muted and speak close to it{{ microphone }}, then record again.
theMicrophoneIsSwitched: The microphone is switched off for this app. Open your phone Settings, tap Apps, Seven Friends, Permissions, Microphone, and choose Allow. Then come back here. If it still does not work, Android must also allow Chrome to use the microphone: Settings, Apps, Chrome, Permissions, Microphone, Allow.
theMicrophoneIsSwitched2: The microphone is switched off for this site. Tap the lock or settings icon next to the web address, allow the microphone, and try again.
pleaseTapTheButton: Please tap the button below and choose Allow.
noMicrophoneWasFound: No microphone was found on this device.
anotherAppIsUsing: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and tap the button below.
theMicrophoneDidNot: The microphone did not start. Tap the button below to try again.
thePhoneIsNot: The phone is not letting the app use the microphone. Press and hold the Seven Friends icon, tap App info, Permissions, Microphone, and choose Allow. Then come back here.
theMicrophoneIsSwitched3: The microphone is switched off. Tap the lock or sliders icon at the left of the web address, then Permissions, and allow the Microphone (no icon: three dots, Settings, Site settings, Microphone). Then tap Try again.
thisBrowserCannotRecord: This browser cannot record audio. Choose a file instead.
